title: The Day the Sword Departs
description: Sun Yu, a disciple of the Guhua Clan, appears to be practicing hard...

mainQuestExcel.title: The Day the Sword Departs
mainQuestExcel.description: Sun Yu, a disciple of the Guhua Clan, appears to be practicing hard...

dialogs.text: Traveler, we meet again.
Are you still training here?
Indeed I am. It's just... so much harder than I expected. I don't know if I'm really that weak, or if I've adopted the wrong method...
Anyway, enough about that. The last time when we fought monsters together, your moves turned out to be quite inspirational.
Traveler, please do me a favor and accompany me for another round of training, will you?
And just like the last time, monster fight or cross-country training? All up to you.
Is Que'er still ignoring you?
Well... She said she had things to do in the city recently, and she hasn't returned...
I've paid her a couple of visits, but she just sends Zhiruo out to make me go away. She still refuses to see me.
*sigh* I honestly don't know what to say to her now...
Monster fight.
Brilliant! I've long wanted to put the swordsmanship I learned into practice...
I'm afraid you can't see my moves clearly.
Y—You are really that skilled? Hahaha, well, then please do me another favor and slow down a bit.
Let's see... There's one place where monsters gather right ahead. Let's go there first, shall we?
Cross-country training.
Brilliant! I've asked an adventurer to help me chart an off-road route... You know, it was only with her help that I was able to train here at all.
She said I just need to reach the destination as quickly as possible. But it seems that I was never quick enough...
So, can you demonstrate how to do it quickly? I'll try my best to keep up.
No problem.
Anyway, I'll be counting on you then. Let's head to the starting point, shall we?
Try not to be left too far behind.
I—I'll certainly try. But to be completely honest, I wasn't built a runner in any sense...
Traveler, we meet again.
Are you still training here?
Indeed I am. It's just... so much harder than I expected. I don't know if I'm really that weak, or if I've adopted the wrong method...
Anyway, enough about that. The last time when we fought monsters together, your moves turned out to be quite inspirational.
Traveler, please do me a favor and accompany me for another round of training, will you?
You've trained here before?
Thankfully, I met a helpful adventurer. She lent me a hand and, using a "mutually executable commission" as an excuse, she brought me in with her.
She even helped me organize a training regimen and offered me all sorts of advice... But, at the same time, I have to help her deal with some commissions for the Adventurers' Guild.
Ahem... Alright, let's get down to business, Traveler.
Here's the thing. I've initiated a training plan for myself that includes fighting monsters and cross-country training.
It's all up to you which one you'd like to help me focus on today, Traveler.
Didn't know you could train in a place like this...

I'm... a bit embarrassed to admit this, but I came here mainly because of the complex terrain and the roaming monsters. I thought it would be a great place to train. The only thing I didn't account for was how hard it was to get here...
Is Que'er still ignoring you?
Well... She said she had things to do in the city recently, and she hasn't returned...
I've paid her a couple of visits, but she just sends Zhiruo out to make me go away. She still refuses to see me.
*sigh* I honestly don't know what to say to her now...
Cross-country training.
Brilliant! Let's keep to the off-road trails we used before to train.
The adventurer said that I just need to reach the destination as quickly as possible. But I've never quite been quick enough...
Could you demonstrate how to do it quickly? I'll try my best to keep up.
No problem.
Anyway, I'll be counting on you then. Let's head to the starting point, shall we?
Try not to be left too far behind.
I—I'll certainly try. But to be completely honest, I wasn't built a runner in any sense...

flow.stepDescription: Reach the destination within the time limit

dialogs.text: *huff* That was tough...
Look at me, making a fool of myself again. I guess I haven't made much progress after all...
Needless to say, I still need more training. Thank you, Traveler. Please, take these as your reward.
How are you going to leave Liyue?
Well... My current plan is to take the merchant's boat and travel by water.
As for my first stop... I'm thinking about Fontaine. I'll probably stay there for a while and make further plans from there.
*sigh* I wonder if I'll be able to convince Que'er to travel with me...
*huff* That was tough...
I apologize. Look at me, making a fool of myself. I didn't expect that I would be so nervous when confronting real monsters...
Needless to say, I still need more training. Anyway, thank you, Traveler. Please, take these as your reward.
Are you really leaving?
I haven't fully decided yet. I still need more time to think it through. Meanwhile, I'll see if I can convince Que'er to leave with me...
*huff* *huff* How... How could you... run so fast...
You are a slow runner.
I—I concede...
Thank you for the demonstration, Traveler. Please, take these as your reward.
About Que'er...
*sigh* She still won't talk to me. I—I've run out of ideas...
How did this become such a dilemma...
About that adventurer...
That adventurer? I met her at the Adventurers' Guild.
She told me that she had accepted a commission from the Guild to work in The Chasm. When she heard that I wanted to come in here, she agreed to take me with her without much hesitation.
But in exchange, I must help her with her commission. Mostly just to look for things though, nothing too toilsome.
It's just... that she's crazily talkative. I had no idea how to deal with people like that...
You still need more training.
*huff* You are absolutely right...
*huff* *huff* How... How could you... run so fast...
You are a slow runner.
I—I concede...
*huff* Finally I get to catch my breath. Oh my, never thought it could be so exhausting...
Thank you for the demonstration, Traveler. Please, take these as your reward.
You still need more training.
*huff* You are absolutely right...
